digest.component_or_area: ADR-0083 reconciler vendor adapter seam documentation
propositions: isinstance checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols silently fail on Python 3.12+ for dynamically-proxying objects due to CPython's switch to inspect.getattr_static, which does not see attributes served by __getattr__
ADR-0083's prescribed isinstance-only capability detection is correct on Python 3.11 but unsafe on Python 3.12+, making it a temporal version-boundary decay not an authoring error
The pattern isinstance(obj, Protocol) or hasattr(obj, member) is the sanctioned fallback that restores proxy-safety and is already implemented in _capability_present
All executable isinstance-against-Protocol sites in the codebase are already proxy-hardened or version-immune and require no source fixes
The ADR text must be amended to document the Python 3.12+ getattr_static behavior change and prescribe the isinstance-primary + hasattr-fallback pattern
